meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (dimensioned concept; CALC masses; ASSUMPTION dimensions) - Rev H active-nose pen, architecture B

axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x, y transverse

components.label: Ball tip
components.function: The point that touches the paper and writes.

components.label: Ink refill (D1 mini)
components.function: Standard replaceable refill; it slides along its axis on a soft constant-force spring so the ball stays on the paper while the nose tilts.

components.label: Constant-force refill spring
components.function: Presses the refill onto the paper with about 0.15 N over 6 mm of axial travel (tilt and correction changes).

components.label: Moving nose (refill carrier)
components.function: Thin titanium tube that holds the refill; it tilts on the gimbal so the tip moves up to about 3 mm against the handle.

components.label: Nose nozzle
components.function: Front of the moving nose; guides the refill tip.

components.label: Rear arm
components.function: Carries the magnets behind the gimbal: the tip moves the opposite way, 1/lever times the magnet motion.

components.label: Magnet hub
components.function: Square hub on the arm carrying four magnets.

components.label: Actuator magnet (y-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (y-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (x-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (x-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Position magnet
components.function: Tiny magnet at the end of the arm read by the 3-D Hall sensor.

components.label: Skid ring (C-shaped heel)
components.function: Rests on the paper and carries the writing force; the ball moves inside its opening. Open at the front so the ink stays visible.

components.label: Front sleeve (fixed grip)
components.function: Where the thumb, index and middle finger rest. It does not move; the nose moves inside it.

components.label: Flexure gimbal (2-axis)
components.function: Laser-cut spring-steel cross flexures: the nose tilts in two directions with no friction or backlash; stiff along the pen.

components.label: Handle shell
components.function: The body you hold: 22 mm thick, easier to grip than a pencil.
components.part: PEEK or glass-filled nylon, 1 mm wall

components.label: Soft-iron ring (flux return)
components.function: Section of the shell over the coils made of soft iron: it closes the magnets' flux through the coils.

components.label: Flat voice coil (y-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (y-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (x-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (x-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: 3-D Hall position sensor
components.function: Reads the nose position in x and y about 10 000 times a second for the position servo.
components.part: TI TMAG5273 (3-D Hall, I2C) or DRV5055 x2

components.label: Control board
components.function: nRF54L15-class MCU with Bluetooth, two coil drivers with current sensing, charger and the IMU. Runs the tremor tracker and the servo.

components.label: Motion sensor (IMU)
components.function: Accelerometer and gyroscope: measures the hand's shake about 2000 times a second (feeds the tracker).

components.label: Rechargeable cell
components.function: EEMB LIR14500, 750 mAh.

components.label: Vibration cue motor
components.function: Gentle buzz cues (write bigger, slow down, check a word).

components.label: USB-C port and button
components.function: Charging and on/off / mode button (side port so the rear cap stays free).

components.label: Rear cap
components.function: Closes the handle.

components.label: Paper sensor (optional)
components.function: Optical sensor beside the nose that sees the paper: page position for capture and the tracker (1 kHz, 2 ms assumed).

components.label: Board magnet (optional)
components.function: Lets the optional guidance board under the paper pull the pen along a letter (about 0.4 N sideways, about 1 N down while guiding). Magnetised along the pen axis. Fixed to the sleeve, not the nose.
components.part: K&J D42-N52 NdFeB disc (6.35 x 3.17 mm)

components.label: Keel for the board magnet (optional)
components.function: Moulded bump under the fixed front sleeve holding the board magnet close to the paper.
components.part: PEEK / TPE, part of the sleeve moulding

components.label: Inertial module frame
components.function: Houses the moving tungsten mass, its coils and flexures.

components.label: Tungsten reaction mass
components.function: A heavy slug pushed sideways by coils: its reaction steadies the whole pen against the shake.
components.part: Tungsten heavy alloy ASTM B777 class 3 (non-magnetic grade)

components.label: Reaction-mass coils
components.function: Four flat coils facing magnets on the slug (2 axes).

board_magnet_checks.added_mass_note: magnet 0.75 g + keel 0.3 g (ASSUMPTION) + 10 % (the P0 wiring convention)
